title: PSX Character Library v1.14: Kombinat added
bodyHtml:
Kombinat is in the Library: 14 adult workers of a Soviet factory, rail yard and metro, from the welder in his canvas cap and the crane operator in a blue headscarf to the track walker in an orange signal vest, the canteen cook, the metro attendant and the night watchman in a fur hat, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 28 packs and 391 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Kombinat joins the Eastern Bloc archive beside Courtyard and Cordon (now 641 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other ten archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 28 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.14.0:

  • Added Kombinat: 14 PSX Soviet Factory, Rail and Metro Workers: Welder, Crane operator, Foundryman, Tram driver, Track walker, Canteen cook, Plant director, Metro attendant, Shift foreman, Union clerk, Locomotive driver, Quality inspector, Night watchman, Mechanic.
  • Eastern Bloc archive: now Courtyard, Cordon and Kombinat.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 28 packs and 391 characters.

Kombinat is also sold on its own page: https://csaf.itch.io/kombinat-psx-soviet-factory-rail-and-metro-workers

How we tested it: every file in the eleven archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (4304 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 462 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: $19.99 today. A rise to $24.99 for new buyers is announced for 7 December 2026 in its own post here; it goes ahead only if the Library has sold at least three times at its full price by that day, and any later change waits for the sales that follow. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 30 live PSX listings, 9 of them sold, 32 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
